name: GridMotion-TS-TW
title: Grid Motion
blurb: A rotated grid of items that slides and shifts as you move your cursor.
description: A grid component using GSAP animations that responds to cursor position. Each row moves in alternating directions with staggered inertia, creating a cascading parallax-like effect.
use_when: You want a playful, interactive hero section that rewards cursor movement with smooth, polished animations.
a11y: Purely visual cursor-driven effect; no keyboard alternative or prefers-reduced-motion guard.
